title: Statement
description: What ran under one engagement: charged runs at their unit prices, refunds the provider recorded, the commission and the provider's net. A record of runs, not of money received: payments are between the parties.

price_per_call.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

plan_id.description: Plan the engagement was agreed under.

calls_charged.description: Runs charged: succeeded runs with a verified receipt.

gross.description: Charged runs at their unit prices, as a decimal string, e.g. "3.60".

refunded.description: Refunds the provider recorded, as a decimal string.

revenue.description: gross less refunded, as a decimal string.

commission_rate.description: EuKollab commission rate as a decimal string, e.g. "0.03".

commission.description: The network's commission on revenue, paid from the provider's commission wallet, as a decimal string.

provider_net.description: revenue less commission, as a decimal string.

settlement.description: direct: money moves between the parties, never through the network.
